visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing black-rimmed glasses and a white T-shirt stands in a brightly lit indoor mall environment. He holds a large paper cup featuring a traditional blue-and-white porcelain pattern (CHAGEE brand) directly toward the camera lens. (2) The man brings the cup to his face and takes a long sip through a slender white straw. He smiles with a delighted expression, squinting his eyes as he looks back at the camera. (3) The scene shifts to a first-person perspective at a stainless steel shop counter. The hands of a staff member in a black uniform are visible as they gesture emphatically while speaking. Several numbered drink stations are seen on the counter surface. (4) A series of graphic overlays and screen captures are presented, showing diagrams of milk tea ingredients and official nutritional information from a mobile application. The text is dense and technical. (5) The man is shown again standing in front of a store sign that says 'ORDER'. He takes another sip of the drink and nods his head as if confirming a thought. (6) A sharp close-up captures the top of the black lid of the cup, specifically highlighting how thin the white straw is. (7) The camera pans across a digital menu board displayed on a screen, listing various tea beverages with their respective prices in Chinese characters. (8) A staff member wearing black gloves and a mask is seen at the preparation area, pouring liquid into the branded cups amidst other kitchen equipment.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A friendly, mid-pitched male voice introduces himself and the beverage brand with high arousal. A constant, upbeat electronic pop BGM with a distinct percussion beat hums in the background. (2) A sharp, wet slurping sound is heard through the straw, followed by a vocalized 'Ah' and positive commentary on the milk intensity. (3) The male speaker's voice lowers slightly in volume as he interacts with a female staff member. The female voice is calm and articulate, explaining the use of 'base milk' and fresh milk. Ambient shop sounds like clinking and pouring are faintly audible. (4) A second male voice with a more technical, professional tone provides further detail about ingredient composition. The music remains steady, maintaining a vibrant energy. (5) The primary male speaker returns to describe the specific scent of jasmine tea with an excited, rising intonation. (6) A percussive 'ding' sound effect emphasizes the menu pricing segment. The male voice speaks rapidly, listing costs and store policies. The music swells toward the end before a final hard cut.
